method.value: MCMC fit of three-parameter infalling shell (V, T, N_HI) interpolating Gronke2015 spectra

evidence.quote: A Markov Chain Monte Carlo calculation is performed to constrain the parameters, based on interpolating a compilation of Ly$\alpha$ spectra(cite: Gronke2015) from the shell model.

findings_qualitative.value: Lyα is blue-skewed, offset ~-150 km/s from CO systemic velocity, indicating infalling gas

evidence.quote: the profile of the observed Ly$\alpha$ line appears to be blue-skewed

claims.hypothesis: Gas is infalling onto the central galaxy of LAB6
claims.experiment: Compare X-shooter Lyα profile to ALMA CO/[CI] systemic velocity; fit shell model
claims.result: Lyα blue-skewed, peak ~-150 km/s; shell infall V≈-34 km/s
claims.finding: Direct kinematic evidence of infall, not necessarily cooling radiation

evidence.quote: our observational result represents direct kinematic evidence that gas is falling into the central region where the SMG is located

claims.hypothesis: Infall is important for feeding the galaxy

evidence.quote: which is negligible in comparison to the consumed material of approximately 1100 M$_{\odot}$yr$^{-1}$ by star formation

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Galactic fountain (fallback) vs cold streams as origin of infalling gas

evidence.quote: it is possible that the gas was ejected earlier as part of the galactic wind from the central region and is falling back

limitations_admitted.value: Uniform shell model over-simplified; results rough estimate

evidence.quote: The above modelling result should be taken as a rough estimate.

referee_caveats_inferred: Redshift inconsistency 2.3691 vs 2.3796 (and z=2.38 field) unexplained
Flux rescaling of calibrator is ad hoc
